sections.brief: Every documented line with type, amount, date and degree: Thiel $15M Protect Ohio Values and $17.5M Saving Arizona (2022), Per Aspera >=$200K, Sacks $1M and the Sacks/Rabois fundraiser, Musk >$290M (America PAC), Thiel 2025-26 giving; employment and investment (Mithril, Narya, Masters, Founders Fund-SpaceX, Tlon $1.1M, Burnham fellowship); government contracts (ICE-Palantir since 2014, ImmigrationOS, DHS BPA; SpaceX $38bn); no Thiel money to Yarvin personally or NatCon; undrawable edges. Figures: money, compare

Rule: a loop is documented only if every arrow is; Valar-Epstein the one closed (commercial) loop; candidate loops with the missing arrow named: Thiel-Vance-office-Palantir (#N31; ICE since 2014, sole-source justification), Sacks portfolio-policy (708/449, waivers), Musk money-DOGE-contracts, Rockbridge; DonorsTrust as shared pipe, not a loop. Figures: flow, compare

Thiel Foundation 990-PF (assets $45.2M 2024; disbursements), Fellowship, Imitatio, Leo Strauss $100K; O'Neill and Masters as former leaders; Seasteading $500K pledge, $1.25M (2011) vs $1.7M (2018), both reported; DonorsTrust mechanism and Thiel grants ($1.4M 2022, $1.28M 2024, $0.43M 2025; ~$7.3M 2021-24 not fully confirmed); no Thiel-EBF grant: same pipe, unknown water; Per Aspera; Rockbridge with no public face. Figures: stats, money, compare

Epstein's 2008 plea; Valar (co-founded by Thiel, led by McCormack and Fitzgerald); $40M LP 2015-16 now ~$170M (NYT); Nov 2014 solicitation, Southern Trust, 'super confidential' (Byline, no IDs); meetings 2014-early 2019, island invitations, 'When are you there?', Saudi reply (EFTA00832976); spokesperson: never went to the island; Barak 'owned by Peter Thiel and JE' graded not supported; Carbyne co-investment; Aug 2015 dinner and the no-transfer rule; DOJ July 2025 memo; Transparency Act, releases, Engelmayer, Aug 2026 report (status Oct 2026); worst-case reading tested for the part. Figures: time, compare
